描述_EN: airia claims that the airia one trainers are engineered to improve running performance. svante berggren who was a runner and inventor started designing shoes in 1992. the claims are based on a theory that a bio mechanical difference affects each stride. it was included in the inaugural exhibition, ‘values of design’, in the v&a gallery at design society in a section exploring the issue of performance as a design value. the key design features are that the sole is thicker on the outside of the foot compared to the thinner big toe side. the leg muscles are utilised in unique capacities and since the shoes alter the muscular usage patterns for the stride with a unique design, the makers claim that users will be able to run faster and/or longer, especially at maximum efforts. this results in a zero drop from the heel to the outside of the mid foot and a 6mm drop from the outside to the inside (known as a “cant” or “slant”) for the purposes of a more even distribution of impact when the foot lands and stability. these trainers were acquired as part of the shekou project, an international partnership between the v&a and china merchant shekou holdings (cmsk) to open a new cultural platform called design society in shekou. these trainers were designed by svante berggren and manufactured by airia. these trainers have a distinctive upward bend in the shoe which is designed so that the shoe rocks in a continuous forward motion. the makers claim that the unusual shape is biomechanically optimised to make serious runners improve their running speed by changing stride and gait patterns.
描述_ZN: Airia声称airia one训练鞋的设计是为了提高跑步性能。 Svante Berggren是一位跑步者和发明家，他在1992年开始设计鞋子。 该说法是基于一个理论，即生物机械差异会影响每个步幅。 该作品被纳入设计协会V&A画廊的开幕展览 "设计的价值 "中，在探索作为设计价值的表现问题的部分。 关键的设计特点是，与较薄的大脚趾侧相比，脚底外侧更厚。 腿部肌肉以独特的能力被利用，由于鞋子以独特的设计改变了步幅的肌肉使用模式，制造商声称用户将能够跑得更快和/或更长，特别是在最大努力下。 这导致了从脚跟到脚中部外侧的零落差和从外侧到内侧的6毫米落差（被称为 "倾斜 "或 "斜面"），目的是为了在脚落地和稳定时更均匀地分配冲击。 这些训练鞋是作为Shekou项目的一部分被收购的，这是V&A和中国商人Shekings（Cmsk）之间的国际合作项目，目的是在Shekou开设一个新的文化平台，叫做Design Society。 这些训练鞋由Svante Berggren设计，由Airia制造。 这些训练鞋有一个独特的向上弯曲的鞋子，其设计是为了让鞋子在连续的向前运动中摇晃。 制造商声称，这种不寻常的形状是经过生物力学优化的，通过改变步幅和步态，使严肃的跑步者提高他们的跑步速度。
